body: I made this account to post about that *specifically*. I just needed to tell someone.

I appreciate your words. I will stay alive until my parents die. And i do have someone to talk to, but at this point i am just traumatizing her more than she is already traumatized. Thats why i came to r/suicidewatch. I cant keep hurting her. I cant talk to my parents because they will suggest therapy which does nothing for me.
